fieldData.description: Describe the thank you page you need and Emergent builds it in minutes: a real URL on your domain, a database write per submission, and the retargeting pixel set on publish.

fieldData.awb---integrations-heading: Everything a Thank You Page Needs, in One Build
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: Describe what happens after a visitor converts. Emergent builds the page, the next step, and the analytics and CRM wiring around it.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
A real thank you page URL

Every thank you page ships on its own URL on your domain, tracked as a conversion goal and targetable by a pixel. An inline form message can't be tracked or retargeted that way.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
A database write per submission

Every visitor who lands on the page becomes a row in a database you own, with source, campaign, and referrer attached. Feed it to HubSpot, Mailchimp, or a dashboard the same day.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Any next step, generated to match

A demo booking after a lead magnet, a related product after a purchase, a calendar link after a form. Describe the next step and Emergent builds the block that leads to it.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Pixel and analytics set on publish

Meta Pixel, a GA4 conversion event, and any custom script fire when the page loads, all set up from the prompt. The page becomes a conversion goal and a retargeting source.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Works everywhere your form does

A custom thank you page for WooCommerce, a Shopify post-purchase page, a WordPress form, or any standalone URL. One build, every surface, one set of submissions in your database.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-6-content:
Full code export

The thank you page and the database it writes to both export to your GitHub. Keep hosting on Emergent or take it anywhere. Nothing is locked inside a plugin, theme, or vendor CRM.

fieldData.acrm---usecase-heading: Thank You Pages You Can Build in Minutes
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Deliver the promise, then earn the second yes

Build a lead magnet thank you page that confirms the download, delivers the file instantly, sets the inbox expectation, and offers one relevant next step. The lead is saved with UTMs and referrer to a database you own, ready to feed HubSpot, Mailchimp, or your own CRM. Tracked as a conversion goal from the first render.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A thank you page delivers a playbook download, offers a demo booking, saves the lead with its source, and fires conversion tracking.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Turn the order confirmation into the second sale

A custom thank you page for a WooCommerce, Shopify, or BigCommerce store that confirms the order, shows delivery timing, and offers a related product or a discount for the next order. Every order lands in your own database in addition to the store's, so post-purchase automation is yours to run.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: An order confirmation page shows delivery progress, upsells a related product, and gives a discount code for the next order.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Confirm the seat, then reduce the no-show

A webinar or event thank you page that confirms the registration, adds the event to the visitor's calendar, sets expectations for the reminder cadence, and invites a colleague. The registration is stored in your database with the source, ready for the reminder sequence and the post-event follow-up.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A webinar confirmation page adds the event to calendars, invites a colleague, and schedules reminder emails and texts.

fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Set a timeline, then remove the reason to leave

A thank you page for a contact form or a demo request that names a response window, offers a self-serve next step, and routes the inquiry to Slack or your CRM. Set the expectation on the page and the follow-up starts on the right foot every time.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A contact thank you page promises a reply within 24 hours, lets the visitor book a call, and posts the enquiry to Slack and HubSpot.

fieldData.awb---how-to-title: How to Build a Thank You Page
fieldData.awb---how-to-description: A thank you page confirms the action, delivers the promise, and moves the visitor to one next step. Describe what it follows and Emergent generates the page, the database write, and the conversion tracking, on your domain.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-1-des: Start with what the visitor just did: submitted a form, bought a product, registered for a webinar, or booked a call. The action decides the confirmation copy, what gets delivered on the page, and the natural next step.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-title: 02 Confirm the action in one line
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Say plainly that it worked and what happens next, such as your playbook arriving in two minutes or order #10482 shipping Tuesday. A specific confirmation stops the refresh and resubmit that creates duplicate leads and orders.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-title: 03 Deliver the promise on the page
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-des: Put the download, the order summary, the calendar link, or the booking time on the page itself, not only in a follow-up email. The visitor gets what they came for immediately, and the email becomes a backup instead of a dependency.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pick one: book a demo after a lead magnet, add a related product after a purchase, or invite a colleague after a webinar registration. One clear next step converts better than a page crowded with options.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build a thank you page that appears after my form is submitted.

alpb---cover-image.alt: Thank you page confirming a signup with a download button

fieldData.alpb---how-to-step-5-title: 05 Save every visitor and fire the tracking
fieldData.alpb---how-to-step-5-des: Write each conversion to a database you own with UTMs, source, and referrer, and fire the GA4 event and Meta Pixel on load. The page becomes a measurable conversion goal and a retargeting audience from the first visit.
fieldData.alpb---how-to-step-6-des: Connect your domain, set the page to noindex, and point the form, checkout, or booking redirect at the new URL. On Shopify, link it from the order confirmation email, since its own thank you page no longer runs scripts.
fieldData.alpb---how-to-step-7-title: 07 Test the next step and iterate
fieldData.alpb---how-to-step-7-des: Generate an A/B variant of the next-step block by prompting, compare next-step conversion by traffic source every week, keep the winner, and change the offer as your campaigns change.

fieldData.awb---integrations-heading: Everything a Customer Satisfaction Survey Needs
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: CSAT, NPS, CES, or all three. Emergent builds the questions, the branching by score, the alerts, and the database behind them.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
CSAT, NPS, CES, and open text in one survey

Every question type satisfaction research uses: a 1-5 CSAT scale, a 0-10 NPS question, a 1-7 CES scale, and open follow-ups. Add or remove a question by describing it.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-2-content:
Every response tied to the customer

Pass the customer ID, account, plan, or ticket ID with the survey link and every response is saved with that context. A low CSAT score becomes an account your team can call today.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Follow-up questions that change by score

Promoters get a review request, passives a feature question, and detractors an open follow-up. CSAT and effort scores branch the same way, set in one line of the prompt.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Alerts on low scores

A Slack alert on every detractor, a HubSpot task on every low CSAT, and an email to the owner for key accounts. Every alert carries the score, the comment, and the customer.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
A live CSAT, NPS, and CES dashboard

Generated with the survey and reading from the response database. Filter by segment, plan, or time window, and share one live view with your team instead of a monthly report.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-6-content:
Responses in a database you own

Every response lands in a table in your project, with no response cap. The survey, the dashboard, and every historical response export to your GitHub whenever you want.

fieldData.awb---how-to-title: How to Create a Customer Satisfaction Survey
fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Pick the metric, tie every answer to the customer, and route low scores to someone who can act. Emergent generates the survey, the follow-ups, the alerts, and the dashboard from one description, with no response cap.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-1-des: Use CSAT right after a transaction, NPS for loyalty over time, and CES for the effort of a single interaction. Pick one headline metric per survey; asking all three at once costs completions before it adds insight.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Send it where the experience just happened: on ticket close, seven days after delivery, at day 30 of onboarding, or at quarter end for B2B accounts. A survey tied to a real moment gets more responses than a long one sent weeks later.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-des: Pair the score with one question about why, one segmentation field such as plan or role, and one improvement question. Branch by score: promoters get a review request, passives a feature question, and detractors an open follow-up.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-title: 04 Tie every response to the customer
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pass the customer ID, account, plan, order, or ticket ID with the survey link, so every answer is saved with its context. Without it, a low score is an anonymous number. With it, it is an account someone can call today.
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build a customer satisfaction survey for my customers.

asqb---cover-image.alt: Customer satisfaction survey with a five-star rating and a CSAT of 4.6

fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-5-title: 05 Route low scores to an owner
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-5-des: Decide who hears about which score: a Slack alert to the CSM on every detractor, a HubSpot task on a low CSAT, an email to the account owner for key accounts. Every alert should carry the score, the comment, and the customer.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-6-des: Emergent generates the survey, the branching, the alerts, and a live CSAT, NPS, and CES dashboard, all reading from a response database you own. Embed it in your app or emails, or share it on your own domain.
fieldData.asqb---how-to-step-7-des: Read the dashboard weekly by segment and product area, follow up on every detractor within a day, and tell customers what changed because of their feedback. Adjust the questions and thresholds by prompting as patterns appear.
fieldData.name: Build a Customer Satisfaction Survey That Acts on Every Low Score
